notes.title: Demo Live Stream
notes.content:
Join to watch the gameplay and ask the developer questions about current features and which features are planned for the Early Access Release in December 2022.

[b]Star Jet Alpha[/b] is a top-down space shooter inspired by classic arcade games.  Progress through each stage by blowing up enemy space stations while avoiding or destroying enemy missiles, space mines and asteroids.  Unlock Star Jet capabilities by completing stages.
